spec.universe: PIT dynamic universe from data/universe-history.json; latest asOf <= signal date
spec.signal: stock close > maximum close of prior 20 sessions
spec.entry: next US trading-session open after signal close
spec.exitExecution: next US trading-session open after close-based stop/circuit/hold trigger

forwardOosRules: Do not change any parameter based on observations after freeze.
Do not redefine the universe, ranking, entry, exit, costs, or gates without assigning a new strategyId.
Do not merge this candidate into Production/main solely from historical validation.
Record every forward signal and realized execution without cherry-picking.
Any bug fix that changes historical or forward signals invalidates this strategyId and requires a new frozen version.
Evaluate forward results separately from all pre-freeze historical metrics.
knownLimitations: Corporate-action and price-history integrity inherit the repository market-data pipeline.
PIT validity inherits the construction quality of data/universe-history.json.
Stop and circuit triggers are close-based and do not model intraday stop execution.
